text: {"label":"Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder Interventions","definition":"Research on children, adolescents, and college students with attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder or its symptoms. It covers parent training, school-based on-task and self-monitoring interventions, social skills, medication, and delay and effort discounting.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Defined by an attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder population, unlike general pediatric and early intervention work, classwide classroom management and the Good Behavior Game, or older intellectual disability research."}
